name: Coffee Monopoly
description: One bean, one cup, one vertically-integrated empire. Stand up plantations and roasters, blanket the cities with coffee shops, and export enough roasted beans to fund the next wave. A rival chain is one step ahead — close the gap before month 48.

goals.description: Operate at least 2 plantations — the bean supply is the foundation of the chain.
Operate at least 2 factories — roasting and bottling happen in-house, not on the world market.
Put coffee_drink on a shelf — the chain isn't real until it reaches a customer.
Reach 35% share of coffee_drink in Metropolis — the richest demographic drinks the most cups.
Reach 30% share of coffee_drink in Eastside — a second city to prove the chain scales.
Bank $4M in cumulative export revenue — the world market is thirsty for roasted beans.
Earn $10M in cumulative net income since day one — a monopoly that doesn't print money isn't a monopoly.
